Analyze the workshop's supplier price and lead-time data (recurring materials list with historical prices and lead times supplied by customer) to produce: (1) a summary of which suppliers/materials show the most price volatility, (2) which show lead-time risk, and (3) a simple tracking template/recommendation for ongoing monitoring. Deliverable: written report with tables based on data the customer supplies.

Process a supplied audio interview transcript (or transcript generated from provided audio) to produce: (1) a searchable index of topics/timestamps, (2) a short summary of each interview segment, (3) a set of pull-quotes with timestamps for reference/promotion. Deliverable: a structured written document (index + summaries + quotes) based on content the customer supplies.

Analyze the seasonal service's appointment and response-time data (booking records, response logs) to produce: (1) a summary of current availability patterns and response-time gaps, (2) clear customer-facing availability/response-time guidelines, (3) a simple template for communicating expected wait times going forward. Deliverable: a written report with tables and a ready-to-use customer communication template, based on data the customer supplies.

Consolidate the volunteer group's donation and attendance records from several inconsistent spreadsheets into one clean, unified dataset. Deliverable: a single organized spreadsheet/table (donation records and attendance records reconciled, duplicates removed, consistent formatting) plus a short written summary of key discrepancies found and recommendations for keeping records consistent going forward, based on the data the customer supplies.

Review the specialty seller's public product listings to identify duplicated and inconsistent descriptions.
